title: Explicit coefficient diagrams, canonical cocones, and localization comparisons
statement: For the internal coefficient rings and fixed derived functors of [def-weil-pbc-finite-derived-tensor-comparison], construct scalar-inclusion morphisms between restricted scalar extensions from their adjunction universal properties. Their identity and composition laws define a functor of cochain complexes along any diagram H of finite coefficient fields. The algebraic-closure extension, restricted to E, is a specified actual vertex and gives a canonical cocone. Exact scalar extension and restriction provide actual isomorphisms from the localizations of each stage and of this vertex to the prescribed derived functor objects. No object is chosen from an unproved existence assertion.

source.place: ExtendScalars and Constructible sections (boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsSubfield_obj, boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl_obj), and TwoColimit section (constructibleCocone_essSurjObj, constructibleCocone_homSurj, constructibleCocone_homInj, constructibleCocone_isFilteredTwoColimit); these are unproved upstream inputs

proof.text: Use extendHom and extendUnit to construct the mixed scalar morphism. Precomposition with the coequalizer epimorphism extendπ gives coefficient inclusion tensor the identity. This equation proves naturality, identities, composition, and the canonical cocone law degree by degree.
Use mapDerivedCategoryFactors and leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory for the exact scalar extension and restriction functors to construct the explicit stage and vertex isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Explicit E1 proof from scalar-extension universal properties and exact-derived factorization equations; coefficient-algebra argument of the parent node.
